（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No. I. O. D. 1044
Date....29.-3.-30.）

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, FRIDAY, MARCH 28, 1930

Philippines Denies Use Of
Mail To Communists

MANILA, Mar. 26.—Following the recent discovery by the Philippine Constabulary of a plot to overthrow the Insular Government and establish Soviet rule in the Philippines, it was suggested to the Governor-General, Mr. Dwight F. Davis, that the Bureau of Posts should be requested to deny the use of the mails to officials of the Proletarian Labour Congress. Officials of the Congress, which is now in session here, and are stated to have affiliations with Communist organizations in Moscow.
Through the Bureau of Posts the Insular Government to-day took its first action against Communists in the Philippines by denying the use of the mails to the Proletarian Labour Congress. This order also extends to 20 alleged Reds, whose personal mail will be confiscated and consigned to the Dead Letter Office. These alleged Reds, who are all under close police surveillance, are threatening litigation with a view to regaining their privileges.
Several letters have so far been confiscated by the Postal authorities. These are alleged to show that several suspected Communists have direct connections with Moscow.
It is also known that money is being sent from the Soviet capital to a certain member of the Philippine Legislature to enable him to distribute Communist propaganda.
The Governor-General is watching the situation closely, though up to the present he has made no statement in connection with it.
—Reuter.

《字林西报》，1930年3月28日，星期五

菲律宾否认允许共产党人使用邮政系统

马尼拉，3月26日电。—继菲律宾保安队最近发现一起旨在推翻岛屿政府并在菲律宾建立苏维埃统治的阴谋后，有人向总督德怀特·F·戴维斯（Dwight F. Davis）先生建议，应要求邮政局禁止无产阶级劳工大会（Proletarian Labour Congress）的官员使用邮政服务。该大会目前正在此地召开，据称其与莫斯科的共产主义组织有联系。
通过邮政局，岛屿政府今日采取了在菲律宾针对共产党人的首次行动，即禁止无产阶级劳工大会使用邮政服务。此项命令还涉及20名所谓的赤色分子，他们的私人信件将被没收并送至死信办公室。这些所谓的赤色分子均处于警方的严密监视之下，他们正威胁提起诉讼，以图恢复其特权。
邮政当局迄今已没收数封信件。据称这些信件显示，几名涉嫌共产党人与莫斯科有直接联系。
另据悉，资金正从苏联首都汇给菲律宾立法机构的一名特定成员，以便其分发共产主义宣传品。
总督正在密切关注局势，尽管截至目前他尚未就此发表任何声明。
—路透社。

（手写批注：）
1930年3月29日

REUTER'S PACIFIC SERVICE
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
No. I. O. D.. 1044
MANILA, MARCH... 2... 3... 30.）

THE RED HAND OF COMMUNISM MADE ITS FIRST PUBLIC
APPEARANCE IN MANILA TO-DAY IN CONNECTION WITH THE
GENERAL REBELLION OF HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS, 14,000
OF WHOM HAVE REFUSED TO ATTEND CLASSES AND ARE
INDULGING IN SERIOUS RIOTING.

THE STRIKE, WHICH STARTED OVER, ALLEGED INSULTING
REMARKS MADE BY AN AMERICAN WOMAN TEACHER AGAINST FILIPINOS,
IS CONTINUING WITH GREATER SERIOUSNESS EVERY DAY.
ORIGINALLY THE STUDENTS DEMANDED THE EXPULSION OF THE
TEACHER IN QUESTION, BUT NOW THEY ARE AGITATING FOR THE
REINSTATEMENT OF FOUR EXPELLED STUDENTS.

THE DISTURBANCES TO-DAY CAUSED THE POLICE AUTHORITIES
TO ORDER ALL AVAILABLE RESERVES TO THE TROUBLE CENTRES.
SEVERAL STUDENTS WERE BADLY INJURED AND ONE WAS KNIFED,
WHILE A YOUNG GIRL WAS STRIPPED AND TRAMPLED UPON BY
THE MOB IN THE GROUNDS OF THE NORTH HIGH SCHOOL. A
POLICE SERGEANT, WHO ATTEMPTED TO RESCUE THE
UNFORTUNATE GIRL, WAS REWARDED WITH A BEATING.

COMMUNIST AGITATORS, LONG KNOWN TO BE SEMI-ACTIVE IN
A QUIET WAY, CAME OUT OPENLY TO-DAY, SOME OF THEM
ADDRESSING 3,000 STUDENTS IN THE WALLED CITY FOR THE
PURPOSE "OF PROTECTING THE RIGHTS OF FILIPINO STUDENTS,
TRAMPLED UPON BY THE FOREIGNERS WHOM WE ARE FEEDING AND WHO
DO NOT KNOW HOW TO APPRECIATE THE HOSPITALITY OF OUR
PEOPLE."

IT IS ESTIMATED IN RELIABLE QUARTERS THAT 10,000
FILIPINOS OF BOTH SEXES HAVE BEEN CONVERTED TO THE CAUSE
OF COMMUNISM DURING THE PAST THREE YEARS, WHILE AT LEAST
20 AGITATORS WITH DIRECT CONNECTIONS WITH MOSCOW ARE KNOWN
TO BE WORKING IN THE PHILIPPINES. - REUTER'S PACIFIC SERVICE.
5/3/30
RBM

路透社太平洋分社
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
登记室
编号 I. O. D.. 1044
马尼拉，1930年3月...2...日...3...。）

共产主义的红色魔爪今日在马尼拉首次公开亮相，这与高中生的大规模反叛有关，其中14,000名学生拒绝上课，并参与严重的骚乱。

此次罢工起因于据称一名美国女教师对菲律宾人发表了侮辱性言论，且事态日益严重。起初，学生们要求驱逐该名教师，但现在他们鼓动要求复学四名被开除的学生。

今日的骚乱导致警方当局命令所有可用的后备力量前往事发中心。数名学生受重伤，一人被刀刺伤，而在北高中（North High School）的操场上，一名年轻女孩被暴民剥光衣服并践踏。一名试图营救这名不幸女孩的警佐反而遭到殴打。

长期以来已知以隐蔽方式半活跃状态的共产主义煽动者今日公开现身，其中一些人在城墙内的城区向3,000名学生发表演讲，目的是“保护被外国人践踏的菲律宾学生的权利，我们供养着这些外国人，而他们却不懂得感激我们人民的好客。”

据可靠方面估计，在过去三年中，已有10,000名男女菲律宾人皈依共产主义事业，同时已知至少有20名与莫斯科有直接联系的煽动者在菲律宾活动。 - 路透社太平洋分社。
1930年3月5日
RBM
